episodes.title: Why Real-World AI Is Harder Than the Benchmark | EliseAI's Mario Martone
episodes.about: What changes when an AI mistake doesn't just hurt a benchmark score, but affects someone's housing or healthcare? EliseAI Head of Applied Research Mario Martone argues that deploying AI in essential industries requires a very different standard of reliability. He explains how EliseAI handles roughly 5 million phone calls a month, why LLMs aren't the right solution for every problem, and how the team combines language models, traditional machine learning, and internally built evaluations to decide what actually works in production.
episodes.why: Out today: EliseAI runs about 5 million housing and healthcare calls a month, and Martone explains why a wrong answer there demands a different reliability bar than a benchmark score.

episodes.title: How the Latest AI Leap Is Disrupting Business Models
episodes.about: AI's latest capability jump is forcing companies to rethink their business models. From Adobe clones to one-person game studios, NLW explores what's changing, what's overhyped, and where new opportunities are emerging. In the headlines: Anthropic's revenue surge, CoreWeave's debt troubles, and Jensen Huang on AI safety.
episodes.why: The latest capability jump is already breaking business models - Adobe clones and one-person game studios - plus Anthropic's revenue surge and CoreWeave's debt troubles in the headlines.

episodes.title: Gemini 4 & Meta's Muse Wonder Are Good. Not Great.
episodes.about: AI news this week: Google's Gemini 4 Argon and Meta's Muse Wonder are finally here, plus Xbox Labs, Epic's big AI pivot and an AI agent vs. Delta customer service. Kevin Pereira and Gavin Purcell dig into two new frontier AI models that are pretty good, but maybe not great: Gemini 4 Argon shines on science, but some early reviewers say it hallucinates.
episodes.why: Discovery pick - a weekly AI news show hosted by Kevin Pereira and Gavin Purcell: hands-on verdicts on Gemini 4 Argon and Meta's Muse Wonder, specific about where each model falls short.

episodes.title: Is This the Cheapest Way to Use AI in 2026? (65+ Models Tested) | Iskander Malikov, Trioma
episodes.about: What if you didn't have to choose between ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, and instead the platform chose for you? That is the idea behind Trioma, a vertically integrated AI ecosystem built in the UAE. Craig Smith sits down with Trioma co-founder and CEO Iskander Malikov to unpack how Trioma's orchestration engine routes prompts across 65 models, and why token price is a misleading metric.
episodes.why: Trioma routes each prompt across 65 different models and tested them all - a practical look at why token price is the wrong number to shop on.

episodes.title: CoreWeave Crash, AI Trade Cracks, Anthropic IPO Red Flags, Bill Gates Doomer
episodes.about: Ben Horowitz fills in for Friedberg as the panel takes up CoreWeave's debt selloff and whether the AI bubble just popped, AI's deflationary impact on decompiled software, Anthropic's investor day and the mixed reactions to it, Anthropic's warning about self-replicating models on IoT devices, and Bill Gates the doomer.
episodes.why: Discovery pick - the weekly tech-and-business roundtable with Chamath, Jason, Sacks and guest Ben Horowitz: CoreWeave's debt selloff, Anthropic's investor day, and a warning about self-replicating models.
